rationale: Romans 8:20-21 speaks of creation subjected to futility and of hope that it will be set free from bondage to decay; commentators reported here read this as taking up the cursed ground of Genesis 3:17-19 and casting its undoing as a future outcome. Genesis 3:17-19 states no promise of reversal in its own words, so promise_fulfillment would claim more than the text supports, and contrast_reversal names the later passage inverting an earlier stated condition. Sourcing caveat: the Genesis 3 background is reported as a near-consensus reading through secondary reports of Moo's NICNT commentary (Precept Austin), and Moo's own page was not read, so confidence is medium-high and the label is strong, not explicit.
